message: This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
text:
Notes Improver is now scheduled once a day at 00:00 (midnight), not woken by ticket events. It still reads the day's DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate's failures, and proposes ideas to the Coordinator. It is unconfirmed, so it does not run yet.

Still open: whether the Coordinator listens for `work.proposed` (until it does, I would forward ideas with `hand_to_coordinator`), and whether to keep or drop `notes_files.count`, which expires in 24 hours.

quotes: make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
